text:
If you're wrapping up the evening outside, tonight is about as easy as it gets. Sunset's already behind us, the air's comfortable at low 40s humidity, and the lake's calm with light northeast wind, so there's no reason not to linger on the water or the porch. It'll cool off nicely overnight, dropping to around 54, clear skies the whole way.

Sunday holds up its end too, mostly sunny with a high near 80, still good for the beach or a lake outing with light south wind and small waves. Just don't push plans too late into the evening: showers move in after 8pm and mean business, with an 80 percent chance and a real half inch or so of rain likely overnight into Monday morning. The lake gets choppy fast once that front arrives, waves building to 3 to 5 feet as south winds pick up into the 15 to 25 knot range, so plan on being off the water Sunday well before dark.
